entities.summary: Panarchism is a political philosophy that envisions the coexistence of multiple political systems within the same geographic area, allowing individuals to freely choose the government under which they wish to live—or to remain unaffiliated with any government at all. The concept extends the principle of freedom of association to the realm of political governance, proposing that states compete for citizens in much the same way businesses compete for consumers.
